name: tts-duet
description: Gemini TTS audio plugin. One-step install delivers the stdio MCP tool surface (mcp__gemini_tts__*) plus the /tts-duet:tts-duet and /tts-duet:tts-duet-setup commands. The full generation pipeline additionally requires an ambient Gemini API key (documented residual).

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Google Gemini API key (aka GOOGLE_API_KEY). Used by the plugin's MCP child for TTS. Stored in your system keychain; never written to project files. NOTE: the full /tts-duet:tts-duet generation pipeline drives a second MCP child that additionally needs this key available ambiently (shell export or ~/.claude/settings.json env) — see INSTALL.md.
